text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As the end of summer training camp drew near—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ――OOOAAAAAHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Fuhahahaha!!!
How do you find it, my personal physician?
The brand-new brilliance of my legs!

text_block_list.name: Gimlet's Attending Physician
text_block_list.text: To be honest, I'm astonished...! There's no other way to describe it than a miraculous recovery...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a final summation of the summer camp, we had Tanino Gimlet's attending doctor
come in person to check her recovery.
Her progress seems more than satisfactory!

text_block_list.name: Gimlet's Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
—Thorough management and unyielding effort.
Above all, this is the result of both your wills combined.
...You really did your best.
choice_data_list: No, it's all thanks to you, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Our utmost gratitude goes to you. We shall respond to your efforts with a magnificent feat!

text_block_list.name: Gimlet's Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
...Having made a splendid recovery,
your body is growing even stronger.
I will be supporting your great achievement from the shadows.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "...I need to... run my own race, too—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And upon returning to the academy—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Well done to have gathered at my place of revelation.
As the appointed hour arrives, I shall reveal it now.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"I shall rise from the shadows, take the stage
where the shining stars gather, and once more
reveal my brilliant, dazzling radiance!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The stage for my complete revival shall be the Kobe Shimbun Hai!!
Witness my rebirth!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
—Could you please tell us the reason
for your sudden change of plans?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Will there be a change of dedicated trainer?! Do you intend to keep her future racing rotation reasonable?!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Revelations mutate into thousands of forms depending on the recipient, at times sparking great conflicts over their true meaning...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"I shall permit that chaos and embrace it!
Crush your words however you see fit!
...However—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Let me make one thing crystal clear.
My Trainer is never going to change.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Tanino Gimlet-san!!
Please talk to us a little more!!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Please give a detailed explanation to the fans as well!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh...! Hahahaha!!
Bwaaaahahahaha!!!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Social Media Platform
text_block_list.text: "Tanino Gimlet's full comeback announcement is here!! But honestly, sticking with the same Trainer caught me a little off guard."

text_block_list.name: A Certain Social Media Platform
text_block_list.text:
"Gimlet's Trainer is getting crazy hate, it's wild.
Must be tough, but Gim seems to trust them, so I'm rooting for 'em."

text_block_list.name: A Certain Social Media Platform
text_block_list.text: "Ugh, I'm so anxious. I really don't want to see her forced into another reckless challenge and end up on break again~"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Heh. This view is finally starting to look worth destroying.
choice_data_list: Having everyone worry this much is actually kind of amusing.
Having everyone worry this much is actually kind of amusing.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Haha! What incredible resilience!!
Now that is truly something!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Kobe Shimbun Hai—the stage of her comeback—
was fast approaching...!
